title: Ashen's Land Mines
description: Watch where you are walking, or you might explode...
body:
![title](https://i.imgur.com/I3QXWwM.png)
## Note: 
- This datapack requires version 0.0.2 or later of ADA. You can download it [HERE](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ashens-datapack-athenaeum)

## How to craft:

- Put 3 TNT in a triangle shape pointing down at the bottom, surrounded with 2 stone on each side. Put a redstone block in the middle with a tripwire hook on top. Or just look at the recipe picture below. 
![recipe](https://i.imgur.com/H6nLMMK_d.jpg?maxwidth=520&shape=thumb&fidelity=high)
